hero_lead: Collision repair serving Lake Arrowhead, CA. Submit a mobile photo estimate and get clear directions, insurance guidance, and repair support from Showtime Collision.
review_quote: Absolutely outstanding service. Car literally looks better than the day I bought it. Could not be more satisfied.
faq1_question: How do Lake Arrowhead customers start?
faq1_answer: Use the guided Carwise photo estimate from a mobile phone, or call Showtime if the vehicle may be unsafe to drive.
faq2_question: Where will my vehicle be repaired?
faq2_answer: The main repair facility is at 32049 Encina Way in Running Springs.
faq3_question: Can Showtime help with an insurance supplement?
faq3_answer: Showtime can document additional required work discovered during inspection or repair and communicate with the insurer.
faq4_answer: Calling ahead or beginning the photo estimate is recommended. Appointment and walk-in availability depend on the shop schedule.
